newsitem.title: USA: Canyon Resources to buy Cahuilla project.
newsitem.headline: Canyon Resources to buy Cahuilla project.

text.p: Canyon Resources Corp said it entered into an agreement to buy the Cahuilla gold project, located in Imperial County, Calif., from Kennecott Exploration Co for an initial 100,000 Canyon shares.
Canyon said it agreed to issue 100,000 shares of Canyon common stock to Kennecott upon execution of the purchase agreement and another 100,000 shares within 18 months.
Upon mine development, Canyon would pay $10 per recoverable ounce of gold, not to exceed $20 million, in common Canyon shares.

The property was comprised of 2,380 acres of mineral leases of private lands, the company said. Kennecott and other companies drilled 211 holes on the property in earlier exploration activities, it said.
Canyon said it planned to conduct substantial drilling, metallurgical and engineering studies and permitting activities on the Cahuilla project over the next 18 months.
